Writer #9 initial pre-experiment registration is durably saved and reopened with every manifest payload verified. Initial protocol SHA-256: `aebdfe90edf392d89433289f7bccc3fc1757abe7f7311381b11170af7b1ae51a`. Complete initial checkpoint ZIP SHA-256: `9a5b6caa4e3a0e817f451815babde41edb5f871a28d9bee016fe990db0146279` (30,322 bytes). No numerical development, calibration or confirmation outcome has been observed.

Fixed mission: qualified repeated sparse-system investigation on four preselected public HB matrices (1138_bus, bcsstk14, bcsstk18, bcsstk24). Fixed native comparison: repeated cold SuperLU (ablation), conventional cached SuperLU (strong comparator), and a source/matrix-bound readiness instrument using the same solver plus two preflight checks. All per-output residual, backward-error and manufactured-solution gates are shared. Eight calibration blocks and twelve later confirmation blocks; q=1,4,16; every failure retained. All local qualified-delivery probabilities and deadlines will be frozen together before confirmation. Ready response and full paid setup remain separate.

A separately frozen finite timing model will compare forecast-only, constructive, wait-and-act, static expert, adaptive nonforecast and adaptive same-signal builders across six preregistered regimes. Demand/adoption/imitation remain assumptions, measured computational primitives remain observations, and authoring/maintenance costs remain unknown where unmetered. The exact source freeze and data hashes will follow before confirmation. Current source acquisition has encountered official server errors; no task substitutions have been made. This is a research registration, not a published manuscript or cleared runtime gate.

Writer #9 numerical preconfirmation freeze is complete. All 288 calibration batches passed the preregistered column-wise numerical criteria; those outcomes were visible before issuing forecasts. The 180 exact probability/deadline targets are now frozen together, before any of the 432 confirmation batches. Forecast file SHA-256: `95ab2aec575f797f6392d6bc1d01a4e22a8815dd5c25e10a5eb0446763a8439d`. Numerical source SHA-256: `6ff30ebcf9a223e1cff760dabae282bd3aeed614089bc139a41c3ea34608bde5`. Complete preconfirmation checkpoint (3,772,567 bytes), SHA-256 `42c0b08d1c6a05eefc6587266e42a3a879124e80ab2375e01b83eae453a9c1f6`, was saved durably, reopened, and all 71 manifest payloads verified. Official download failures required pinned public research copies of the same four matrices; dimensions/nonzeros match official metadata, while original-server byte equality remains unverified. A pattern-only candidate was rejected before scientific measurement. No task or acceptance threshold was replaced.

One engineering summary-serialization defect occurred after all 36 development cells and is retained with its partial-cost limitation. The correction changed metadata serialization only. Column checks, setup/RHS costs, failed-attempt retention, calibration completeness, source/data binding and phase/cumulative numerical budgets were reviewed before confirmation. Ready forecasts explicitly condition on both the factor and RHS already being available; full preparation remains charged.

The separate timing model has its own upcoming preconfirmation freeze. No customer adoption, revenue, deployed financial execution or full-cost commercial advantage is established. Existing publication ownership and runtime holds remain unchanged.
